svg.title: One file has both staged and later unstaged changes in JupyterLab
svg.desc: 1: The same file appears in Staged and Changed. 2: HEAD versus INDEX shows the selected snapshot. 3: Only the wraparound test is staged; the full-turns edit is still outside the index. 4: Minus unstages the snapshot without discarding edits.
